images.alt: Каменные геометрические орнаменты древних построек Митлы — иллюстрация
images.prompt: Wide 16:9 photorealistic editorial travel illustration for a premium tourism website hero. Archaeological Mitla Oaxaca Mexico, close oblique view of authentic low Zapotec palace stone wall and doorway, intricate small geometric stepped greca stone mosaic bands within rectangular panels above red plaster base, open stone courtyard and dry hills far behind. No Maya pyramid, no Chichen Itza, no fantasy monumental stairs, no people, no readable letters. Natural light and realistic textures, quieter uncluttered space on left for white title, composition highlights to right. No text, logos, watermark, collage, frame or inset.
